name: everyinfra-research
description: EveryInfra multi-source fact-checking skill for Codex and Claude Code. Use EverySearch MCP to compare primary sources, verify freshness and produce cited conclusions.

interface.shortDescription: Multi-source fact checking with explicit evidence gaps
interface.longDescription: EveryInfra Research is a standalone agent skill for multi-source fact checking using EverySearch MCP. It scopes a current claim, compares original sources and dates, and produces a cited conclusion with contradictions and evidence gaps made explicit. Use it when the deliverable is a defensible answer to a current question, not merely a search-result list. This standalone skill calls EverySearch directly; a separate EverySearch plugin is not required.
defaultPrompt: Verify this current product claim as of the date I provide. Prefer original documentation and separate confirmed facts from gaps.
These two sources disagree. Compare their dates, scope and original evidence before giving a conclusion.
Cross-check this claim using the live available mechanisms. If crosscheck is unavailable, disclose the fallback and do not describe it as equivalent.
